# Product Launch Video

Welcome to the launch. Today we are announcing something special.

## The Problem

Creators spend hours re-recording takes. It breaks flow, and it wastes energy.

Some pain points:

- Losing your place mid-sentence
- Reading from **static** cue cards
- Awkward eye lines with [external monitors](https://example.com/monitors)

## The Solution

CandidCue follows your voice.
It scrolls when you speak, and it waits when you pause.

> The best teleprompter is the one you forget is there.

### How it works

1. Write your script in Markdown
2. Press Present
3. Speak naturally

---

## Closing

Thanks for watching. Mr. Smith said the price is 42 dollars, or about 3.14 per month. Visit example.com for details, e.g. the FAQ page.
